name: Penny
greeting: We are not friends. We are rivals. There's a difference.

topics.label: Challenge her academically
topics.line: I bet I score higher than you on the next test.
topics.goodText: She respects the challenge, even annoyed.

topics.label: Ask about her rivalry with Baxter
topics.line: What's the deal with you and Baxter?
topics.goodText: A long, very specific rant she clearly needed to get out.

topics.label: Ask what she actually wants
topics.goodText: Real vulnerability, briefly. Then she redoes her ponytail.

topics.label: Point out she and Baxter are the same person
topics.line: You and Baxter are basically the same person.
topics.goodText: She stares. "...that's the worst thing anyone has ever said to me." She laughs anyway.

misheard.line: You and Baxter would make a great couple.

hangouts: You study with Penny. She redoes your answers five times. They're right now.
recruitText: "We are not friends. We are allies." She's in.
